label: PF Backlog 273
title: Issue tracker (IS-<TAG>-<nnn>) + 1:1 backlog mapping + RCCA-gated close
body: core/issues.py: canonical finding registry (per scope) with destination-tagged ids, priority(P0-P3), module, severity, kind, RCCA(root_cause/corrective/preventive/fixed_where/generalized/guideline_ref/product_ref), and a 1:1 backlog_ref (reciprocal link via backlog.link). Reuses defect_loop (RCCA ingest), backlog tags/qualify, and the existing issue_tracker. Backlog items linked to an issue cannot reach completed without a complete RCCA. API: /api/v1/issues (+ /{id}, POST, /{id}/{rcca|link|status}).
